description: Use this when the user wants to make a business card, a business card template or printable business cards. Only the name is required; title, company, phone, email, website, address, tagline, layout (classic, centered, band, monogram, qr), accent colour, QR code (website or vCard), back side and paper (US Letter or A4) are optional. Returns a print-at-home PDF with 10 cards per sheet in the layout of 3.5 x 2 in perforated card sheets (8371, 5371, 28371) or A4 85 x 55 mm, a print-shop PDF with bleed and crop marks, and a vCard, plus a live preview. Long text is shrunk or wrapped to fit and the result says when something was shortened. Does not add logos or photos, design flyers, or make name badges or address labels.

accent.description: Accent colour as hex or a colour name, e.g. #1F4E79 (default), teal, burgundy.

address.description: Address on one line, e.g. 120 Market St, Suite 400, San Francisco, CA 94105.

back.description: Back side: none (default), brand (solid accent colour with the company name and tagline) or qr (QR code). Adds a back page for double-sided printing.

company.description: Company or business name, e.g. Acme Studio LLC.

layout.description: Card design: classic (left-aligned, default), centered, band (split colour band), monogram (minimal with initials) or qr (large QR code on the side). Example: band.

name.description: Name printed on the card, e.g. Jane Doe. The only field the card needs.

paper.description: Paper: letter (US Letter, 3.5 x 2 in cards, default) or a4 (85 x 55 mm cards).

phone.description: Phone number as it should print, e.g. (415) 555-0100 or +44 20 7946 0958.

qr.description: QR code on the card: website (opens the website), vcard (saves the contact to the phone), or none. true picks website if given, else vcard. Default none, except the qr layout (vcard).

tagline.description: Optional short slogan, e.g. Brand design for small teams.

title.description: Job title, e.g. Senior Product Designer.

name: generate_business_cards
title: Generate business cards
